_comment: The delivery-format vocabulary (issue #74 / ADR-0059). One definition of the forms an artifact may be delivered in: the trained result as it is, a merged single-file model for serving, and a quantised local-inference format for running on your own machine. The control plane (through temper_core.delivery) and the trainer image both read this file, so the two sides cannot drift about what a format is called, what kind it maps to, what it is for, or which conversion produces it. A value two components must agree on is defined once and read, never retyped. `conversion` is null for the as-trained format (no conversion step) and names the step that produces the others; the order property that quantisation must follow a full-precision merge is enforced by temper_core.delivery.production_steps, not by this data alone.

formats.what_for: The trained change on its own - the canonical artifact, small and easy to move. Apply it to the base model with PEFT, or load it where you already serve the base.
The base model with the trained change built into its full weights at full precision. One self-contained model you can serve directly, without composing pieces at load time.
A compact local-inference version of the merged model, the 'run it on your own machine' format. Smaller than the merged model, and loaded by a local runtime such as llama.cpp.
